snippet.title: Touge Max - Saisoku Drift Master ps1 - trash drift racing game
snippet.description: as racing it's sucks, but i liked secret on level and hidden shortcut, thats only interesting thing here, it got story mode that was deleted from peak performance english version, it's just bunch of simple missions and one of later mission unbeatable without drift and drift control sucks here
